biercEN: A strife of interests masquerading as a contest of principles. The conduct of public affairs for private advantage.
revelationES: Política necesita que sigas indignado, nunca que sigas informado.
revelationEN: You think Politics represents you. Politics represents whoever funds it.

biercES: Anguila en el barro fundamental sobre el que se erige la superestructura de la sociedad organizada. Cuando se retuerce, confunde la agitación de su cola con el temblor del edificio.
biercEN: An eel in the fundamental mud upon which the superstructure of organized society is reared. When he wriggles he mistakes the agitation of his tail for the trembling of the edifice. As compared with the statesman, he suffers the disadvantage of being alive.
revelationES: Cada Político jura ser el último honesto. El siguiente jura lo mismo.
revelationEN: Politician promises to change everything. It changes names on the ballot and stays the same.

biercES: Casa de expiación, o capilla penitencial, provista de varios reclinatorios de arrepentimiento, a diferencia de la monogamia, que solo tiene uno.
biercEN: A house of atonement, or expiatory chapel, fitted with several stools of repentance, as distinguished from monogamy, which has but one.
revelationES: Poligamia es una de esas palabras que usamos para no admitir que improvisamos todo.
revelationEN: You call Polygamy the habit of never questioning anything deeper.

biercES: Patriota fósil del período agrícola temprano, hallado en la vieja roca colorada que subyace bajo las llanuras del oeste; caracterizado por una inusual amplitud de orejas.
biercEN: A fossil patriot of the early agricultural period, found in the old red soapstone underlying Kansas; characterized by an uncommon spread of ear, which some naturalists contend gave him the power of flight, though Professors Morse and Whitney, pursuing independent lines of thought, have ingeniously pointed out that had he possessed it he would have gone elsewhere. In the picturesque speech of his period, some fragments of which have come down to us, he was known as "The Matter with Kansas."
revelationES: Populista es una de esas palabras que usamos para no admitir que improvisamos todo.
revelationEN: Everyone uses Populist to sound smarter than the conversation actually required.

biercES: Expuesto a una propiedad mutable a través de las vicisitudes de la posesión.
biercEN: Exposed to a mutable ownership through vicissitudes of possession.
revelationES: Portátil es exactamente lo que cada quien necesita que sea para tener la razón.
revelationEN: Portable is exactly whatever each person needs it to be to feel right.

biercES: Especie de ganso indígena de Portugal. En su mayoría carecen de plumas y son imperfectamente comestibles, incluso rellenos de ajo.
biercEN: A species of geese indigenous to Portugal. They are mostly without feathers and imperfectly edible, even when stuffed with garlic.
revelationES: Nombras Portugués y asumes que ya lo entendiste. Ponerle nombre no es lo mismo que entenderlo.
revelationEN: Portuguese looks simple until you actually have to live it, not just describe it.

biercES: Equivocado a viva voz.
biercEN: Mistaken at the top of one's voice.
revelationES: Positivo es fácil de admirar en un libro. Incómodo de sostener en la vida real.
revelationEN: You talk about Positive as if it were universal. At most, it is your version of it this week.

biercES: Filosofía que niega nuestro conocimiento de lo Real y afirma nuestra ignorancia de lo Aparente.
biercEN: A philosophy that denies our knowledge of the Real and affirms our ignorance of the Apparent. Its longest exponent is Comte, its broadest Mill and its thickest Spencer.
revelationES: Crees entender Positivismo. La verdad es que nadie lo sabe, y actúan con tu misma confianza.
revelationEN: Positivism is one of those words we use to avoid admitting we are improvising everything.

biercES: Tribunal de apelaciones que revoca el juicio de los contemporáneos de un autor popular, siendo el apelante su oscuro competidor.
biercEN: An appellate court which reverses the judgment of a popular author's contemporaries, the appellant being his obscure competitor.
revelationES: Posteridad es exactamente lo que cada quien necesita que sea para tener la razón.
revelationEN: Posterity changes meaning right when it is convenient for it to change.

biercES: Apto para beber. Se dice que el agua es potable; algunos incluso la declaran nuestra bebida natural, aunque hasta ellos la encuentran agradable solo cuando padecen el trastorno recurrente llamado sed, del cual es medicina.
biercEN: Suitable for drinking. Water is said to be potable; indeed, some declare it our natural beverage, although even they find it palatable only when suffering from the recurrent disorder known as thirst, for which it is a medicine. Upon nothing has so great and diligent ingenuity been brought to bear in all ages and in all countries, except the most uncivilized, as upon the invention of substitutes for water. To hold that this general aversion to that liquid has no basis in the preservative instinct of the race is to be unscientific--and without science we are as the snakes and toads.
revelationES: Damos por hecho Potable hasta que un día falta, y ahí recién le prestamos atención.
revelationEN: You take Potable for granted until one day it is missing, and only then do you notice it.

biercES: Lima provista para los dientes de las ratas de la reforma. El número de planes para abolirla iguala al de los reformistas que la padecen, más el de los filósofos que no saben nada de ella.
biercEN: A file provided for the teeth of the rats of reform. The number of plans for its abolition equals that of the reformers who suffer from it, plus that of the philosophers who know nothing about it. Its victims are distinguished by possession of all the virtues and by their faith in leaders seeking to conduct them into a prosperity where they believe these to be unknown.
revelationES: Cuentas Pobreza que no tienes para imaginar la vida que no vas a vivir.
revelationEN: Poverty is the one god every religion worships without admitting it.

biercES: Pedir que las leyes del universo se anulen en beneficio de un solo peticionante, confesadamente indigno.
biercEN: To ask that the laws of the universe be annulled in behalf of a single petitioner confessedly unworthy.
revelationES: Confundes tener una opinión sobre Rezar con haberlo entendido.
revelationEN: What you call Pray would probably be something else if you had to explain it without help.

biercES: Miembro de una raza experimental y aparentemente insatisfactoria, anterior a la Creación, que vivió en condiciones difíciles de concebir. Poco se sabe de ellos salvo que le proveyeron una esposa a Caín y una controversia a los teólogos.
biercEN: One of an experimental and apparently unsatisfactory race of antedated Creation and lived under conditions not easily conceived. Melsius believed them to have inhabited "the Void" and to have been something intermediate between fishes and birds. Little is known of them beyond the fact that they supplied Cain with a wife and theologians with a controversy.
revelationES: Preadamita es de esas cosas que criticas en otros y justificas en ti mismo.
revelationEN: Pre-Adamite changes meaning right when it is convenient for it to change.

biercES: En derecho, una decisión, regla o práctica previa que, a falta de una ley expresa, tiene la fuerza y autoridad que un Juez decida otorgarle, simplificando así enormemente su tarea de hacer lo que le plazca.
biercEN: In Law, a previous decision, rule or practice which, in the absence of a definite statute, has whatever force and authority a Judge may choose to give it, thereby greatly simplifying his task of doing as he pleases. As there are precedents for everything, he has only to ignore those that make against his interest and accentuate those in the line of his desire. Invention of the precedent elevates the trial-at-law from the low estate of a fortuitous ordeal to the noble attitude of a dirigible arbitrament.
revelationES: Hablas de Precedente como si fuera universal. Es, como mucho, tu versión de esta semana.
revelationEN: You name Precedent and assume you understood it. Naming a thing is not the same as understanding it.

biercES: Antes del almuerzo.
biercEN: Anteprandial.
revelationES: Todos citan Precipitado. Pocos se detienen a vivir según lo que citan.
revelationEN: You mistake having an opinion about Precipitate for having understood it.

biercES: Doctrina según la cual todo ocurre de acuerdo con un programa. Esta doctrina no debe confundirse con la de la preordinación, que sostiene que todo está programado, pero no afirma su ocurrencia.
biercEN: The doctrine that all things occur according to programme. This doctrine should not be confused with that of foreordination, which means that all things are programmed, but does not affirm their occurrence, that being only an implication from other doctrines by which this is entailed. The difference is great enough to have deluged Christendom with ink, to say nothing of the gore. With the distinction of the two doctrines kept well in mind, and a reverent belief in both, one may hope to escape perdition if spared.
revelationES: Predestinación exige autenticidad, siempre y cuando se parezca a todos los demás.
revelationEN: Nobody chose the rules of Predestination. Everyone defends them as if they had written them.

biercES: El salario de la coherencia.
biercEN: The wage of consistency.
revelationES: Le llamas Aprieto a la costumbre de no cuestionar nada más profundo.
revelationEN: You mistake having an opinion about Predicament for having understood it.

biercES: La etapa preparatoria del desengaño.
biercEN: The preparatory stage of disillusion.
revelationES: Predilección es una de esas palabras que usamos para no admitir que improvisamos todo.
revelationEN: You assumed Predilection for years. You never asked why, until it was already too late.

biercES: Un factor no advertido en la creación.
biercEN: An unnoted factor in creation.
revelationES: Le llamas Preexistencia a la costumbre de no cuestionar nada más profundo.
revelationEN: You name Pre-Existence and assume you understood it. Naming a thing is not the same as understanding it.

biercES: Un sentimiento, o estado de ánimo, inducido por la errónea creencia de que una cosa es mejor que otra.
biercEN: A sentiment, or frame of mind, induced by the erroneous belief that one thing is better than another.
revelationES: Diste por sentado Preferencia durante años. Nunca preguntaste por qué, hasta que ya era tarde.
revelationEN: Preference is easy to admire in a book. Uncomfortable to live by in real life.

biercES: Perteneciente a un período temprano y a un museo. Anterior al arte y la práctica de perpetuar la falsedad.
biercEN: Belonging to an early period and a museum. Antedating the art and practice of perpetuating falsehood.
revelationES: Tu relación con Prehistórico es la más larga y menos honesta que tendrás.
revelationEN: Everyone says Prehistoric does not matter. Nobody says it for free.

biercES: Opinión vagabunda sin medios visibles de sustento.
biercEN: A vagrant opinion without visible means of support.
revelationES: Diste por sentado Prejuicio durante años. Nunca preguntaste por qué, hasta que ya era tarde.
revelationEN: Prejudice looks simple until you actually have to live it, not just describe it.

biercES: Funcionario eclesiástico dotado de un grado superior de santidad y una gorda prebenda. Miembro de la aristocracia del Cielo. Un caballero de Dios.
biercEN: A church officer having a superior degree of holiness and a fat preferment. One of Heaven's aristocracy. A gentleman of God.
revelationES: Damos por hecho Prelado hasta que un día falta, y ahí recién le prestamos atención.
revelationEN: Prelate sounds profound until someone asks for a definition and everyone goes quiet.

biercES: El derecho de un soberano a equivocarse.
biercEN: A sovereign's right to do wrong.
revelationES: Todos usan Prerrogativa para sonar más inteligentes de lo que la conversación exigía.
revelationEN: Everyone uses Prerogative to sound smarter than the conversation actually required.

biercES: Aquel que sostiene la convicción de que a las autoridades de gobierno de la Iglesia debe llamárselas presbíteros.
biercEN: One who holds the conviction that the government authorities of the Church should be called presbyters.
revelationES: Presbiteriano te parece obvio solo porque nunca lo pusiste a prueba de verdad.
revelationEN: You mistake having an opinion about Presbyterian for having understood it.

biercES: La conjetura de un médico sobre qué prolongará mejor la situación, con el menor daño posible al paciente.
biercEN: A physician's guess at what will best prolong the situation with least harm to the patient.
revelationES: Receta médica cambia de significado exactamente cuando te conviene que cambie.
revelationEN: You assumed Prescription for years. You never asked why, until it was already too late.

biercES: Esa parte de la eternidad que divide el dominio de la decepción del reino de la esperanza.
biercEN: That part of eternity dividing the domain of disappointment from the realm of hope.
revelationES: Lo que llamas Presente probablemente sería otra cosa si te tocara explicarlo sin ayuda.
revelationEN: Present is exactly whatever each person needs it to be to feel right.

biercES: Espantosamente vestido según la moda del momento y el lugar.
biercEN: Hideously appareled after the manner of the time and place.
revelationES: Hablas de Presentable como si fuera universal. Es, como mucho, tu versión de esta semana.
revelationEN: You talk about Presentable as if it were universal. At most, it is your version of it this week.

biercES: Guiar la acción de un cuerpo deliberativo hacia un resultado deseable.
biercEN: To guide the action of a deliberative body to a desirable result. In Journalese, to perform upon a musical instrument; as, "He presided at the piccolo."
revelationES: Crees entender Presidir. La verdad es que nadie lo sabe, y actúan con tu misma confianza.
revelationEN: Everyone uses Preside to sound smarter than the conversation actually required.

biercES: El chancho engrasado del juego de campo de la política americana.
biercEN: The greased pig in the field game of American politics.
revelationES: Presidencia es fácil de admirar en un libro. Incómodo de sostener en la vida real.
revelationEN: Everyone quotes Presidency. Few pause to actually live by what they quote.

biercES: La figura principal de un pequeño grupo de hombres de quienes, y solo de quienes, se sabe con certeza que inmensas cantidades de sus compatriotas no querían a ninguno como presidente.
biercEN: The leading figure in a small group of men of whom-- and of whom only--it is positively known that immense numbers of their countrymen did not want any of them for President.
revelationES: Presidente necesita que sigas indignado, nunca que sigas informado.
revelationEN: President divides people into teams so they fight over what both teams already lost.

biercES: Un mentiroso en su estado de oruga.
biercEN: A liar in the caterpillar state.
revelationES: Todos citan Embustero. Pocos se detienen a vivir según lo que citan.
revelationEN: You search for the meaning of Prevaricator your whole life. Maybe the point is exactly not finding it.

biercES: Valor, más una suma razonable por el desgaste de la conciencia al exigirlo.
biercEN: Value, plus a reasonable sum for the wear and tear of conscience in demanding it.
revelationES: Precio no compra la felicidad, pero alquila una imitación bastante convincente.
revelationEN: You chase Price to stop worrying about Price. It does not work that way.

biercES: Jefe de una iglesia, especialmente una iglesia de Estado sostenida por contribuciones involuntarias. El Primado de Inglaterra es el Arzobispo de Canterbury, un amable anciano que ocupa el Palacio de Lambeth mientras vive, y la Abadía de Westminster cuando muere. Suele estar muerto.
biercEN: The head of a church, especially a State church supported by involuntary contributions. The Primate of England is the Archbishop of Canterbury, an amiable old gentleman, who occupies Lambeth Palace when living and Westminster Abbey when dead. He is commonly dead.
revelationES: Todos usan Primado para sonar más inteligentes de lo que la conversación exigía.
revelationEN: Primate is one of those things you criticize in others and excuse in yourself.

biercES: Lugar de castigos y recompensas. El poeta nos asegura que...
biercEN: A place of punishments and rewards. The poet assures us that--
revelationES: Prisión verdadero no necesita anunciarse cada 24 horas en una historia.
revelationEN: You mistake Prison for having someone nearby. They are not always the same thing.

biercES: Caballero militar con un bastón de mariscal de campo en la mochila y un impedimento en su esperanza.
biercEN: A military gentleman with a field-marshal's baton in his knapsack and an impediment in his hope.
revelationES: Todos dicen odiar Soldado raso. Todos aceptarían un poco, en privado.
revelationEN: The history of Private is written by whoever had it, not whoever suffered it.

biercES: El órgano rudimentario de un elefante, que le sirve en lugar del cuchillo y tenedor que la Evolución aún le ha negado.
biercEN: The rudimentary organ of an elephant which serves him in place of the knife-and-fork that Evolution has as yet denied him. For purposes of humor it is popularly called a trunk.
revelationES: Nadie te lo dice, pero Trompa es solo la forma elegante de aceptar que no hay respuesta.
revelationEN: Proboscis is one of those things you criticize in others and excuse in yourself.

biercES: El árbitro final en las disputas internacionales. Antiguamente estas disputas se resolvían por contacto físico entre los disputantes, con argumentos tan simples como la lógica rudimentaria de la época podía proveer: la espada, la lanza, etcétera. Con el crecimiento de la prudencia en asuntos militares, el proyectil fue ganando cada vez más favor.
biercEN: The final arbiter in international disputes. Formerly these disputes were settled by physical contact of the disputants, with such simple arguments as the rudimentary logic of the times could supply--the sword, the spear, and so forth. With the growth of prudence in military affairs the projectile came more and more into favor, and is now held in high esteem by the most courageous. Its capital defect is that it requires personal attendance at the point of propulsion.
revelationES: Proyectil parece simple hasta que te toca vivirlo, no solo describirlo.
revelationEN: Projectile changes meaning right when it is convenient for it to change.

biercES: Evidencia con un matiz más de verosimilitud que de improbabilidad. El testimonio de dos testigos creíbles frente al de uno solo.
biercEN: Evidence having a shade more of plausibility than of unlikelihood. The testimony of two credible witnesses as opposed to that of only one.
revelationES: Nadie te lo dice, pero Prueba es solo la forma elegante de aceptar que no hay respuesta.
revelationEN: You think you understand Proof. The truth is nobody does, and they act with your same confidence.

biercES: Malhechor que expía el haber vuelto tu escritura un disparate, permitiendo que el tipógrafo la vuelva ininteligible.
biercEN: A malefactor who atones for making your writing nonsense by permitting the compositor to make it unintelligible.
revelationES: Todos citan Corrector de pruebas. Pocos se detienen a vivir según lo que citan.
revelationEN: Proof-Reader is one of those things you criticize in others and excuse in yourself.

biercES: Cualquier cosa material, sin valor particular, que A puede retener frente a la codicia de B. Lo que gratifica la pasión de posesión en uno y la frustra en todos los demás. El objeto de la breve rapacidad y la larga indiferencia del hombre.
biercEN: Any material thing, having no particular value, that may be held by A against the cupidity of B. Whatever gratifies the passion for possession in one and disappoints it in all others. The object of man's brief rapacity and long indifference.
revelationES: Confundes tener una opinión sobre Propiedad con haberlo entendido.
revelationEN: Property changes meaning right when it is convenient for it to change.

biercES: El arte y la práctica de vender la propia credibilidad para entrega futura.
biercEN: The art and practice of selling one's credibility for future delivery.
revelationES: Profecía es fácil de admirar en un libro. Incómodo de sostener en la vida real.
revelationEN: You assumed Prophecy for years. You never asked why, until it was already too late.

biercES: Una vista, por lo general desalentadora. Una expectativa, por lo general prohibida.
biercEN: An outlook, usually forbidding. An expectation, usually forbidden.
revelationES: Nombras Perspectiva y asumes que ya lo entendiste. Ponerle nombre no es lo mismo que entenderlo.
revelationEN: You search for the meaning of Prospect your whole life. Maybe the point is exactly not finding it.

biercES: Inesperada y notoriamente beneficioso para la persona que lo describe así.
biercEN: Unexpectedly and conspicuously beneficial to the person so describing it.
revelationES: Lo que llamas Providencial probablemente sería otra cosa si te tocara explicarlo sin ayuda.
revelationEN: Providential sounds profound until someone asks for a definition and everyone goes quiet.

biercES: Una alcahueta escondida detrás de su propia compostura.
biercEN: A bawd hiding behind the back of her demeanor.
revelationES: Confundes tener una opinión sobre Mojigata con haberlo entendido.
revelationEN: You search for the meaning of Prude your whole life. Maybe the point is exactly not finding it.

biercES: En asuntos literarios, convertirse en el elemento fundamental de un cono de críticos.
biercEN: In literary affairs, to become the fundamental element in a cone of critics.
revelationES: Publicar cambia de villano cada década. El guion es sorprendentemente el mismo.
revelationEN: You think you decide for yourself. Publish just let you pick from its options.

biercES: Una de las dos cosas que principalmente conducen al éxito, especialmente en política. La otra es la Palanca.
biercEN: One of the two things mainly conducive to success, especially in politics. The other is Pull.
revelationES: Empuje es de esas cosas que criticas en otros y justificas en ti mismo.
revelationEN: You assumed Push for years. You never asked why, until it was already too late.

biercES: Antigua filosofía, nombrada por su inventor. Consistía en una absoluta incredulidad hacia todo, salvo el propio Pirronismo. Sus profesores modernos han agregado también eso.
biercEN: An ancient philosophy, named for its inventor. It consisted of an absolute disbelief in everything but Pyrrhonism. Its modern professors have added that.
revelationES: Buscas el sentido de Pirronismo toda la vida. Puede que el punto sea justo no encontrarlo.
revelationEN: Pyrrhonism sounds profound until someone asks for a definition and everyone goes quiet.

biercES: Mujer por quien se rige el reino cuando hay un rey, y por medio de quien se rige cuando no lo hay.
biercEN: A woman by whom the realm is ruled when there is a king, and through whom it is ruled when there is not.
revelationES: Buscas Reina para sentirte seguro. Solo cambias de qué tienes miedo.
revelationEN: Queen corrupts. The interesting part is how fast you find the excuse.

biercES: Instrumento de tortura que produce un ganso y comúnmente empuña un asno. Este uso de la pluma ya es obsoleto, pero su equivalente moderno, la lapicera de acero, es empuñada por la misma Presencia eterna.
biercEN: An implement of torture yielded by a goose and commonly wielded by an ass. This use of the quill is now obsolete, but its modern equivalent, the steel pen, is wielded by the same everlasting Presence.
revelationES: Confundes tener una opinión sobre Pluma de ganso con haberlo entendido.
revelationEN: Quill sounds profound until someone asks for a definition and everyone goes quiet.

biercES: Vaina portátil en la que el estadista antiguo y el abogado aborigen llevaban sus argumentos más livianos.
biercEN: A portable sheath in which the ancient statesman and the aboriginal lawyer carried their lighter arguments.
revelationES: Nombras Carcaj y asumes que ya lo entendiste. Ponerle nombre no es lo mismo que entenderlo.
revelationEN: You assumed Quiver for years. You never asked why, until it was already too late.

biercES: Absurdamente caballeresco, como Don Quijote.
biercEN: Absurdly chivalric, like Don Quixote. An insight into the beauty and excellence of this incomparable adjective is unhappily denied to him who has the misfortune to know that the gentleman's name is pronounced Ke-ho-tay.
revelationES: Confundes tener una opinión sobre Quijotesco con haberlo entendido.
revelationEN: You assumed Quixotic for years. You never asked why, until it was already too late.

biercES: Número suficiente de miembros de un cuerpo deliberativo para salirse con la suya y su propia manera de lograrlo.
biercEN: A sufficient number of members of a deliberative body to have their own way and their own way of having it. In the United States Senate a quorum consists of the chairman of the Committee on Finance and a messenger from the White House; in the House of Representatives, of the Speaker and the devil.
revelationES: Quórum es una de esas palabras que usamos para no admitir que improvisamos todo.
revelationEN: Quorum is exactly whatever each person needs it to be to feel right.

biercES: El acto de repetir erróneamente las palabras de otro. Las palabras repetidas erróneamente.
biercEN: The act of repeating erroneously the words of another. The words erroneously repeated.
revelationES: Cita es fácil de admirar en un libro. Incómodo de sostener en la vida real.
revelationEN: You search for the meaning of Quotation your whole life. Maybe the point is exactly not finding it.

biercES: Número que muestra cuántas veces cabe una suma de dinero perteneciente a una persona en el bolsillo de otra; por lo general, tantas veces como logre metérsela allí.
biercEN: A number showing how many times a sum of money belonging to one person is contained in the pocket of another--usually about as many times as it can be got there.
revelationES: Crees entender Cociente. La verdad es que nadie lo sabe, y actúan con tu misma confianza.
revelationEN: Quotient is exactly whatever each person needs it to be to feel right.

biercES: En una república, aquellos que ejercen una autoridad suprema atemperada por elecciones fraudulentas. La chusma es como el sagrado Simurgh de la fábula arábiga: omnipotente a condición de no hacer nada.
biercEN: In a republic, those who exercise a supreme authority tempered by fraudulent elections. The rabble is like the sacred Simurgh, of Arabian fable--omnipotent on condition that it do nothing. (The word is Aristocratese, and has no exact equivalent in our tongue, but means, as nearly as may be, "soaring swine.")
revelationES: Chusma es exactamente lo que cada quien necesita que sea para tener la razón.
revelationEN: Rabble is one of those things you criticize in others and excuse in yourself.

biercES: Instrumento argumentativo antiguamente muy usado para persuadir a los devotos de una fe falsa de abrazar la verdad viva. Como llamado a los no convertidos, el potro nunca tuvo particular eficacia, y hoy se lo tiene en poca estima popular.
biercEN: An argumentative implement formerly much used in persuading devotees of a false faith to embrace the living truth. As a call to the unconverted the rack never had any particular efficacy, and is now held in light popular esteem.
revelationES: Lo que llamas Potro probablemente sería otra cosa si te tocara explicarlo sin ayuda.
revelationEN: Rack is easy to admire in a book. Uncomfortable to live by in real life.

biercES: Elevación relativa en la escala del valor humano.
biercEN: Relative elevation in the scale of human worth.
revelationES: Damos por hecho Rango hasta que un día falta, y ahí recién le prestamos atención.
revelationEN: You mistake having an opinion about Rank for having understood it.

biercES: La compra de aquello que ni pertenece al vendedor, ni puede pertenecer al comprador. La más improductiva de las inversiones.
biercEN: The purchase of that which neither belongs to the seller, nor can belong to the buyer. The most unprofitable of investments.
revelationES: Rescate te parece obvio solo porque nunca lo pusiste a prueba de verdad.
revelationEN: You call Ransom the habit of never questioning anything deeper.

biercES: Providencia sin industria. El ahorro del poder.
biercEN: Providence without industry. The thrift of power.
revelationES: Le llamas normal a lo que Rapacidad repite lo suficiente.
revelationEN: You follow the rules of Rapacity to belong. Nobody tells you they are negotiable for some.

biercES: Un 'conejo galés', en boca de quienes carecen de humor, que señalan que no es en verdad un conejo. A quienes se les puede explicar solemnemente que el plato conocido como 'sapo en agujero' tampoco es en verdad un sapo.
biercEN: A Welsh rabbit, in the speech of the humorless, who point out that it is not a rabbit. To whom it may be solemnly explained that the comestible known as toad-in-a-hole is really not a toad, and that riz-de-veau a la financiere is not the smile of a calf prepared after the recipe of a she banker.
revelationES: Rarebit es exactamente lo que cada quien necesita que sea para tener la razón.
revelationEN: Rarebit is exactly whatever each person needs it to be to feel right.

biercES: Un necio considerado desde otro ángulo.
biercEN: A fool considered under another aspect.
revelationES: Confundes tener una opinión sobre Bribón con haberlo entendido.
revelationEN: Everyone uses Rascal to sound smarter than the conversation actually required.

biercES: Estupidez militante. La actividad de un intelecto nublado.
biercEN: Stupidity militant. The activity of a clouded intellect.
revelationES: Bribonería cambia de significado exactamente cuando te conviene que cambie.
revelationEN: You search for the meaning of Rascality your whole life. Maybe the point is exactly not finding it.

biercES: Insensible al valor de nuestro consejo.
biercEN: Insensible to the value of our advice.
revelationES: Imprudente es una de esas palabras que usamos para no admitir que improvisamos todo.
revelationEN: You think you understand Rash. The truth is nobody does, and they act with your same confidence.

biercES: Desprovisto de todas las ilusiones salvo las de la observación, la experiencia y la reflexión.
biercEN: Devoid of all delusions save those of observation, experience and reflection.
revelationES: Racional es exactamente lo que cada quien necesita que sea para tener la razón.
revelationEN: Everyone quotes Rational. Few pause to actually live by what they quote.

biercES: Nuestro hermano postrado, Homo ventrambulans.
biercEN: Our prostrate brother, Homo ventrambulans.
revelationES: Crees entender Serpiente de cascabel. La verdad es que nadie lo sabe, y actúan con tu misma confianza.
revelationEN: Rattlesnake is one of those things you criticize in others and excuse in yourself.

biercES: Instrumento usado por el caucásico para realzar su belleza, por el mongol para hacer el ridículo, y por el afroamericano para afirmar su valía.
biercEN: An instrument used by the Caucasian to enhance his beauty, by the Mongolian to make a guy of himself, and by the Afro-American to affirm his worth.
revelationES: Confundes tener una opinión sobre Navaja de afeitar con haberlo entendido.
revelationEN: You assumed Razor for years. You never asked why, until it was already too late.

biercES: El radio de acción de la mano humana. El área dentro de la cual es posible (y habitual) gratificar directamente la propensión a la provisión.
biercEN: The radius of action of the human hand. The area within which it is possible (and customary) to gratify directly the propensity to provide.
revelationES: Alcance es exactamente lo que cada quien necesita que sea para tener la razón.
revelationEN: You take Reach for granted until one day it is missing, and only then do you notice it.

biercES: El cuerpo general de lo que uno lee. En nuestro país consiste, por regla general, en novelas de provincia, cuentos 'en dialecto' y humor en jerga.
biercEN: The general body of what one reads. In our country it consists, as a rule, of Indiana novels, short stories in "dialect" and humor in slang.
revelationES: Lo que llamas Lectura probablemente sería otra cosa si te tocara explicarlo sin ayuda.
revelationEN: Reading is one of those things you criticize in others and excuse in yourself.

biercES: El conservadurismo de mañana inyectado en los asuntos de hoy.
biercEN: The conservatism of to-morrow injected into the affairs of to-day.
revelationES: Lo que llamas Radicalismo probablemente sería otra cosa si te tocara explicarlo sin ayuda.
revelationEN: Radicalism sounds profound until someone asks for a definition and everyone goes quiet.

biercES: Mineral que despide calor y estimula el órgano con el cual un científico hace de necio.
biercEN: A mineral that gives off heat and stimulates the organ that a scientist is a fool with.
revelationES: Radio es fácil de admirar en un libro. Incómodo de sostener en la vida real.
revelationEN: You name Radium and assume you understood it. Naming a thing is not the same as understanding it.

biercES: El principal de los muchos dispositivos mecánicos que nos permiten alejarnos de donde estamos hacia donde no estamos mejor. Por eso el optimista lo tiene en gran estima, pues le permite hacer el trayecto con gran rapidez.
biercEN: The chief of many mechanical devices enabling us to get away from where we are to where we are no better off. For this purpose the railroad is held in highest favor by the optimist, for it permits him to make the transit with great expedition.
revelationES: Nadie te lo dice, pero Ferrocarril es solo la forma elegante de aceptar que no hay respuesta.
revelationEN: Everyone uses Railroad to sound smarter than the conversation actually required.

biercES: Perteneciente a cierto orden arquitectónico, también conocido como Normal Americano. La mayoría de los edificios públicos de Estados Unidos son de orden Destartalado.
biercEN: Pertaining to a certain order of architecture, otherwise known as the Normal American. Most of the public buildings of the United States are of the Ramshackle order, though some of our earlier architects preferred the Ironic. Recent additions to the White House in Washington are Theo-Doric, the ecclesiastic order of the Dorians. They are exceedingly fine and cost one hundred dollars a brick.
revelationES: Destartalado es de esas cosas que criticas en otros y justificas en ti mismo.
revelationEN: Ramshackle is one of those words we use to avoid admitting we are improvising everything.

biercES: El arte de representar la naturaleza tal como la ven los sapos. El encanto que impregna un paisaje pintado por un topo, o un relato escrito por una oruga medidora.
biercEN: The art of depicting nature as it is seen by toads. The charm suffusing a landscape painted by a mole, or a story written by a measuring-worm.
revelationES: Lo que llamas Realismo probablemente sería otra cosa si te tocara explicarlo sin ayuda.
revelationEN: Realism changes meaning right when it is convenient for it to change.

biercES: El sueño de un filósofo loco. Lo que quedaría en la copela si se ensayara un fantasma. El núcleo de un vacío.
biercEN: The dream of a mad philosopher. That which would remain in the cupel if one should assay a phantom. The nucleus of a vacuum.
revelationES: Realidad es de esas cosas que criticas en otros y justificas en ti mismo.
revelationEN: You mistake having an opinion about Reality for having understood it.

biercES: Aparentemente.
biercEN: Apparently.
revelationES: Damos por hecho En verdad hasta que un día falta, y ahí recién le prestamos atención.
revelationEN: Really feels obvious to you only because you never really put it to the test.

biercES: En asuntos militares americanos, esa parte expuesta del ejército más cercana al Congreso.
biercEN: In American military matters, that exposed part of the army that is nearest to Congress.
revelationES: Nadie te lo dice, pero Retaguardia es solo la forma elegante de aceptar que no hay respuesta.
revelationEN: Rear is one of those things you criticize in others and excuse in yourself.

biercES: Pesar probabilidades en la balanza del deseo.
biercEN: To weigh probabilities in the scales of desire.
revelationES: Llamas Razonar a la gente que aguanta tus historias sin cobrar terapia.
revelationEN: Reason is measured by who stays once there is nothing left to gain by staying.

biercES: Propensión del prejuicio.
biercEN: Propensitate of prejudice.
revelationES: Razón verdadero no necesita anunciarse cada 24 horas en una historia.
revelationEN: Reason is measured by who stays once there is nothing left to gain by staying.

biercES: Accesible al contagio de nuestras propias opiniones. Hospitalario a la persuasión, la disuasión y la evasión.
biercEN: Accessible to the infection of our own opinions. Hospitable to persuasion, dissuasion and evasion.
revelationES: Razonable se mide en quién se queda cuando ya no hay nada que ganar quedándose.
revelationEN: Real Reasonable does not need to announce itself every 24 hours in a story.

biercES: Proponente de un nuevo mal gobierno que ha fracasado en establecerlo.
biercEN: A proponent of a new misrule who has failed to establish it.
revelationES: Rebelde te parece obvio solo porque nunca lo pusiste a prueba de verdad.
revelationEN: Everyone quotes Rebel. Few pause to actually live by what they quote.

biercES: Rememorar con añadidos algo que antes no se sabía.
biercEN: To recall with additions something not previously known.
revelationES: Lo que llamas Recordar probablemente sería otra cosa si te tocara explicarlo sin ayuda.
revelationEN: Recollect is exactly whatever each person needs it to be to feel right.

biercES: Suspensión de hostilidades. Tregua armada con el propósito de desenterrar a los muertos.
biercEN: A suspension of hostilities. An armed truce for the purpose of digging up the dead.
revelationES: Crees entender Reconciliación. La verdad es que nadie lo sabe, y actúan con tu misma confianza.
revelationEN: You take Reconciliation for granted until one day it is missing, and only then do you notice it.

biercES: Buscar una justificación para una decisión ya tomada.
biercEN: To seek a justification for a decision already made.
revelationES: Reconsiderar suena profundo hasta que alguien pide una definición y todos se quedan callados.
revelationEN: You name Reconsider and assume you understood it. Naming a thing is not the same as understanding it.

biercES: En política americana, otra tirada de dados, concedida al jugador contra quien están cargados.
biercEN: In American politics, another throw of the dice, accorded to the player against whom they are loaded.
revelationES: Recuento parece simple hasta que te toca vivirlo, no solo describirlo.
revelationEN: You search for the meaning of Recount your whole life. Maybe the point is exactly not finding it.

biercES: Una clase particular de abatimiento para aliviar una fatiga general.
biercEN: A particular kind of dejection to relieve a general fatigue.
revelationES: Damos por hecho Recreación hasta que un día falta, y ahí recién le prestamos atención.
revelationEN: Everyone uses Recreation to sound smarter than the conversation actually required.

biercES: Persona distinguible de un civil por su uniforme, y de un soldado por su andar.
biercEN: A person distinguishable from a civilian by his uniform and from a soldier by his gait.
revelationES: Diste por sentado Recluta durante años. Nunca preguntaste por qué, hasta que ya era tarde.
revelationEN: Everyone quotes Recruit. Few pause to actually live by what they quote.

biercES: En la Iglesia de Inglaterra, la Tercera Persona de la Trinidad parroquial, siendo el Coadjutor y el Vicario las otras dos.
biercEN: In the Church of England, the Third Person of the parochial Trinity, the Curate and the Vicar being the other two.
revelationES: Damos por hecho Rector hasta que un día falta, y ahí recién le prestamos atención.
revelationEN: You take Rector for granted until one day it is missing, and only then do you notice it.

biercES: Liberación de los pecadores de la pena de su pecado, mediante su asesinato de la deidad contra la que pecaron. La doctrina de la Redención es el misterio fundamental de nuestra santa religión.
biercEN: Deliverance of sinners from the penalty of their sin, through their murder of the deity against whom they sinned. The doctrine of Redemption is the fundamental mystery of our holy religion, and whoso believeth in it shall not perish, but have everlasting life in which to try to understand it.
revelationES: Redención es fácil de admirar en un libro. Incómodo de sostener en la vida real.
revelationEN: Redemption is easy to admire in a book. Uncomfortable to live by in real life.

biercES: Reparación sin satisfacción.
biercEN: Reparation without satisfaction.
revelationES: Hablas de Desagravio como si fuera universal. Es, como mucho, tu versión de esta semana.
revelationEN: Redress is one of those things you criticize in others and excuse in yourself.

biercES: Superfluo; innecesario; de más.
biercEN: Superfluous; needless; de trop.
revelationES: Redundante es de esas cosas que criticas en otros y justificas en ti mismo.
revelationEN: Nobody tells you, but Redundant is just the elegant way of accepting there is no answer.

biercES: Ley para someter la legislación propuesta a votación popular, con el fin de conocer el nosenso de la opinión pública.
biercEN: A law for submission of proposed legislation to a popular vote to learn the nonsensus of public opinion.
revelationES: Referéndum es exactamente lo que cada quien necesita que sea para tener la razón.
revelationEN: Referendum feels obvious to you only because you never really put it to the test.

biercES: Acción de la mente por la cual obtenemos una visión más clara de nuestra relación con las cosas de ayer, y podemos evitar los peligros que no volveremos a encontrar.
biercEN: An action of the mind whereby we obtain a clearer view of our relation to the things of yesterday and are able to avoid the perils that we shall not again encounter.
revelationES: Confundes tener una opinión sobre Reflexión con haberlo entendido.
revelationEN: Reflection is exactly whatever each person needs it to be to feel right.

biercES: Cosa que satisface sobre todo a los reformistas opuestos a la reformación.
biercEN: A thing that mostly satisfies reformers opposed to reformation.
revelationES: Lo que llamas Reforma probablemente sería otra cosa si te tocara explicarlo sin ayuda.
revelationEN: Reform is exactly whatever each person needs it to be to feel right.

biercES: Cualquier cosa que asegure protección a alguien en peligro. Moisés y Josué proveyeron seis ciudades de refugio, a las que podía huir quien hubiera quitado una vida por accidente, cuando era perseguido por los parientes del difunto.
biercEN: Anything assuring protection to one in peril. Moses and Joshua provided six cities of refuge--Bezer, Golan, Ramoth, Kadesh, Schekem and Hebron--to which one who had taken life inadvertently could flee when hunted by relatives of the deceased. This admirable expedient supplied him with wholesome exercise and enabled them to enjoy the pleasures of the chase; whereby the soul of the dead man was appropriately honored by observances akin to the funeral games of early Greece.
revelationES: Refugio te parece obvio solo porque nunca lo pusiste a prueba de verdad.
revelationEN: You mistake having an opinion about Refuge for having understood it.

biercES: Denegación de algo deseado; como la mano de una doncella entrada en años a un pretendiente rico y apuesto; una franquicia valiosa a una corporación adinerada, por un concejal; la absolución a un rey impenitente, por un sacerdote, y así sucesivamente.
biercEN: Denial of something desired; as an elderly maiden's hand in marriage, to a rich and handsome suitor; a valuable franchise to a rich corporation, by an alderman; absolution to an impenitent king, by a priest, and so forth. Refusals are graded in a descending scale of finality thus: the refusal absolute, the refusal conditional, the refusal tentative and the refusal feminine. The last is called by some casuists the refusal assentive.
revelationES: Negativa suena profundo hasta que alguien pide una definición y todos se quedan callados.
revelationEN: You think you understand Refusal. The truth is nobody does, and they act with your same confidence.

biercES: Insignias, joyas y vestimenta distintivas de órdenes tan antiguas y honorables como los Caballeros de Adán, los Visionarios del Disparate Detectable y otras hermandades de nombres igualmente rimbombantes y vacíos.
biercEN: Distinguishing insignia, jewels and costume of such ancient and honorable orders as Knights of Adam; Visionaries of Detectable Bosh; the Ancient Order of Modern Troglodytes; the League of Holy Humbug; the Golden Phalanx of Phalangers; the Genteel Society of Expurgated Hoodlums; the Mystic Alliances of Gorgeous Regalians; Knights and Ladies of the Yellow Dog; the Oriental Order of Sons of the West; the Blatherhood of Insufferable Stuff; Warriors of the Long Bow; Guardians of the Great Horn Spoon; the Band of Brutes; the Impenitent Order of Wife-Beaters; the Sublime Legion of Flamboyant Conspicuants; Worshipers at the Electroplated Shrine; Shining Inaccessibles; Fee-Faw-Fummers of the Inimitable Grip; Jannissaries of the Broad-Blown Peacock; Plumed Increscencies of the Magic Temple; the Grand Cabal of Able-Bodied Sedentarians; Associated Deities of the Butter Trade; the Garden of Galoots; the Affectionate Fraternity of Men Similarly Warted; the Flashing Astonishers; Ladies of Horror; Cooperative Association for Breaking into the Spotlight; Dukes of Eden; Disciples Militant of the Hidden Faith; Knights-Champions of the Domestic Dog; the Holy Gregarians; the Resolute Optimists; the Ancient Sodality of Inhospitable Hogs; Associated Sovereigns of Mendacity; Dukes-Guardian of the Mystic Cess-Pool; the Society for Prevention of Prevalence; Kings of Drink; Polite Federation of Gents-Consequential; the Mysterious Order of the Undecipherable Scroll; Uniformed Rank of Lousy Cats; Monarchs of Worth and Hunger; Sons of the South Star; Prelates of the Tub-and-Sword.
revelationES: Regalía es una de esas palabras que usamos para no admitir que improvisamos todo.
revelationEN: Regalia is exactly whatever each person needs it to be to feel right.

biercES: Hija de la Esperanza y el Miedo, que le explica a la Ignorancia la naturaleza de lo Incognoscible.
biercEN: A daughter of Hope and Fear, explaining to Ignorance the nature of the Unknowable.
revelationES: Religión parece simple hasta que te toca vivirlo, no solo describirlo.
revelationEN: Religion sounds profound until someone asks for a definition and everyone goes quiet.

biercES: Receptáculo para objetos sagrados como astillas de la vera cruz, costillas de santos, orejas del asno de Balaam, el pulmón del gallo que llamó a Pedro al arrepentimiento, y demás. Los relicarios suelen ser de metal, y provistos de una cerradura para impedir que el contenido salga y obre milagros en momentos inoportunos.
biercEN: A receptacle for such sacred objects as pieces of the true cross, short-ribs of the saints, the ears of Balaam's ass, the lung of the cock that called Peter to repentance and so forth. Reliquaries are commonly of metal, and provided with a lock to prevent the contents from coming out and performing miracles at unseasonable times. A feather from the wing of the Angel of the Annunciation once escaped during a sermon in Saint Peter's and so tickled the noses of the congregation that they woke and sneezed with great vehemence three times each. It is related in the "Gesta Sanctorum" that a sacristan in the Canterbury cathedral surprised the head of Saint Dennis in the library. Reprimanded by its stern custodian, it explained that it was seeking a body of doctrine. This unseemly levity so raged the diocesan that the offender was publicly anathematized, thrown into the Stour and replaced by another head of Saint Dennis, brought from Rome.
revelationES: Le llamas Relicario a la costumbre de no cuestionar nada más profundo.
revelationEN: You name Reliquary and assume you understood it. Naming a thing is not the same as understanding it.

biercES: Grado de distinción entre la notoriedad y la fama: algo más soportable que la primera, y algo más intolerable que la segunda.
biercEN: A degree of distinction between notoriety and fame--a little more supportable than the one and a little more intolerable than the other. Sometimes it is conferred by an unfriendly and inconsiderate hand.
revelationES: Nombras Renombre y asumes que ya lo entendiste. Ponerle nombre no es lo mismo que entenderlo.
revelationEN: You take Renown for granted until one day it is missing, and only then do you notice it.

biercES: Satisfacción que se otorga por un agravio, y que se descuenta de la satisfacción sentida al cometerlo.
biercEN: Satisfaction that is made for a wrong and deducted from the satisfaction felt in committing it.
revelationES: Buscas el sentido de Reparación toda la vida. Puede que el punto sea justo no encontrarlo.
revelationEN: Reparation feels obvious to you only because you never really put it to the test.

biercES: Insulto prudente a modo de respuesta. Practicado por caballeros con una aversión constitucional a la violencia, pero una fuerte disposición a ofender.
biercEN: Prudent insult in retort. Practiced by gentlemen with a constitutional aversion to violence, but a strong disposition to offend. In a war of words, the tactics of the North American Indian.
revelationES: Réplica ingeniosa te parece obvio solo porque nunca lo pusiste a prueba de verdad.
revelationEN: Everyone uses Repartee to sound smarter than the conversation actually required.

biercES: El fiel asistente y seguidor del Castigo. Suele manifestarse en un grado de reforma que no es incompatible con la continuidad del pecado.
biercEN: The faithful attendant and follower of Punishment. It is usually manifest in a degree of reformation that is not inconsistent with continuity of sin.
revelationES: Le llamas Arrepentimiento a la costumbre de no cuestionar nada más profundo.
revelationEN: You talk about Repentance as if it were universal. At most, it is your version of it this week.

biercES: Reproducción de una obra de arte hecha por el mismo artista que hizo el original. Se la llama así para distinguirla de una 'copia', hecha por otro artista.
biercEN: A reproduction of a work of art, by the artist that made the original. It is so called to distinguish it from a "copy," which is made by another artist. When the two are made with equal skill the replica is the more valuable, for it is supposed to be more beautiful than it looks.
revelationES: Confundes tener una opinión sobre Réplica con haberlo entendido.
revelationEN: You name Replica and assume you understood it. Naming a thing is not the same as understanding it.

biercES: Escritor que adivina su camino hacia la verdad, y la disipa con una tempestad de palabras.
biercEN: A writer who guesses his way to the truth and dispels it with a tempest of words.
revelationES: Le llamas Reportero a la costumbre de no cuestionar nada más profundo.
revelationEN: You talk about Reporter as if it were universal. At most, it is your version of it this week.

biercES: Cesar de importunar.
biercEN: To cease from troubling.
revelationES: Todos usan Reposar para sonar más inteligentes de lo que la conversación exigía.
revelationEN: You search for the meaning of Repose your whole life. Maybe the point is exactly not finding it.

biercES: En política nacional, miembro de la Cámara Baja en este mundo, y sin esperanza discernible de ascenso en el próximo.
biercEN: In national politics, a member of the Lower House in this world, and without discernible hope of promotion in the next.
revelationES: Diste por sentado Representante durante años. Nunca preguntaste por qué, hasta que ya era tarde.
revelationEN: You talk about Representative as if it were universal. At most, it is your version of it this week.

biercES: En teología, el estado de un mortal desdichado, condenado desde antes de nacer. La doctrina de la reprobación fue enseñada por Calvino, cuyo gozo en ella se veía algo empañado por su triste convicción sincera de que, si bien algunos están predestinados a la perdición, otros lo están a la salvación.
biercEN: In theology, the state of a luckless mortal prenatally damned. The doctrine of reprobation was taught by Calvin, whose joy in it was somewhat marred by the sad sincerity of his conviction that although some are foredoomed to perdition, others are predestined to salvation.
revelationES: Le llamas Reprobación a la costumbre de no cuestionar nada más profundo.
revelationEN: Reprobation sounds profound until someone asks for a definition and everyone goes quiet.

biercES: Nación en la que, siendo lo mismo lo que gobierna y lo gobernado, solo hay una autoridad permitida para hacer cumplir una obediencia optativa.
biercEN: A nation in which, the thing governing and the thing governed being the same, there is only a permitted authority to enforce an optional obedience. In a republic, the foundation of public order is the ever lessening habit of submission inherited from ancestors who, being truly governed, submitted because they had to. There are as many kinds of republics as there are graduations between the despotism whence they came and the anarchy whither they lead.
revelationES: República promete cambiarlo todo. Cambia de nombre en la boleta y sigue igual.
revelationEN: After every Republic, the country stays the same and the winner does better.

biercES: Misa por los muertos que, según nos aseguran los poetas menores, los vientos cantan sobre las tumbas de sus favoritos. A veces, para variar el espectáculo, cantan una elegía fúnebre.
biercEN: A mass for the dead which the minor poets assure us the winds sing o'er the graves of their favorites. Sometimes, by way of providing a varied entertainment, they sing a dirge.
revelationES: Todos citan Réquiem. Pocos se detienen a vivir según lo que citan.
revelationEN: You call Requiem the habit of never questioning anything deeper.

biercES: Incapaz de irse.
biercEN: Unable to leave.
revelationES: Nadie te lo dice, pero Residente es solo la forma elegante de aceptar que no hay respuesta.
revelationEN: Resident is one of those things you criticize in others and excuse in yourself.

biercES: Renunciar a un honor por una ventaja. Renunciar a una ventaja por una ventaja mayor.
biercEN: To renounce an honor for an advantage. To renounce an advantage for a greater advantage.
revelationES: Renunciar te parece obvio solo porque nunca lo pusiste a prueba de verdad.
revelationEN: You mistake having an opinion about Resign for having understood it.

biercES: Obstinado en un curso de acción que aprobamos.
biercEN: Obstinate in a course that we approve.
revelationES: Resuelto es fácil de admirar en un libro. Incómodo de sostener en la vida real.
revelationEN: You talk about Resolute as if it were universal. At most, it is your version of it this week.

biercES: El vástago de un idilio entre una calva y una cuenta bancaria.
biercEN: The offspring of a liaison between a bald head and a bank account.
revelationES: Hablas de Respetabilidad como si fuera universal. Es, como mucho, tu versión de esta semana.
revelationEN: Respectability is one of those things you criticize in others and excuse in yourself.

biercES: Aparato que se coloca sobre la nariz y la boca de un habitante de Londres, para filtrar el universo visible en su paso hacia los pulmones.
biercEN: An apparatus fitted over the nose and mouth of an inhabitant of London, whereby to filter the visible universe in its passage to the lungs.
revelationES: Respirador es una de esas palabras que usamos para no admitir que improvisamos todo.
revelationEN: Respirator feels obvious to you only because you never really put it to the test.

biercES: Suspensión de hostilidades contra un asesino sentenciado, para permitirle al Ejecutivo determinar si el crimen no pudo haber sido cometido por el fiscal. Cualquier interrupción en la continuidad de una expectativa desagradable.
biercEN: A suspension of hostilities against a sentenced assassin, to enable the Executive to determine whether the murder may not have been done by the prosecuting attorney. Any break in the continuity of a disagreeable expectation.
revelationES: Nadie te lo dice, pero Indulto temporal es solo la forma elegante de aceptar que no hay respuesta.
revelationEN: Everyone uses Respite to sound smarter than the conversation actually required.

biercES: Como un simple ciudadano americano enduquesándose en su logia, o afirmando su importancia en el Esquema de las Cosas como unidad elemental de un desfile.
biercEN: Like a simple American citizen beduking himself in his lodge, or affirming his consequence in the Scheme of Things as an elemental unit of a parade.
revelationES: Le llamas Resplandeciente a la costumbre de no cuestionar nada más profundo.
revelationEN: You mistake having an opinion about Resplendent for having understood it.

biercES: Dar respuesta, o revelar de otro modo la conciencia de haber inspirado interés en lo que Herbert Spencer llama 'coexistencias externas'.
biercEN: To make answer, or disclose otherwise a consciousness of having inspired an interest in what Herbert Spencer calls "external coexistences," as Satan "squat like a toad" at the ear of Eve, responded to the touch of the angel's spear. To respond in damages is to contribute to the maintenance of the plaintiff's attorney and, incidentally, to the gratification of the plaintiff.
revelationES: Lo que llamas Responder probablemente sería otra cosa si te tocara explicarlo sin ayuda.
revelationEN: Nobody tells you, but Respond is just the elegant way of accepting there is no answer.

biercES: Carga desmontable que se traslada fácilmente a los hombros de Dios, el Destino, la Fortuna, la Suerte o el vecino. En tiempos de la astrología, era costumbre descargarla sobre una estrella.
biercEN: A detachable burden easily shifted to the shoulders of God, Fate, Fortune, Luck or one's neighbor. In the days of astrology it was customary to unload it upon a star.
revelationES: Lo que llamas Responsabilidad probablemente sería otra cosa si te tocara explicarlo sin ayuda.
revelationEN: Everyone uses Responsibility to sound smarter than the conversation actually required.

biercES: La fundación o dotación de universidades y bibliotecas públicas mediante donación o legado.
biercEN: The founding or endowing of universities and public libraries by gift or bequest.
revelationES: Restitución es exactamente lo que cada quien necesita que sea para tener la razón.
revelationEN: You call Restitution the habit of never questioning anything deeper.

biercES: Benefactor; filántropo.
biercEN: Benefactor; philanthropist.
revelationES: Buscas el sentido de Restituidor toda la vida. Puede que el punto sea justo no encontrarlo.
revelationEN: Nobody tells you, but Restitutor is just the elegant way of accepting there is no answer.

biercES: La roca natural sobre la que se erige el Templo de la Ley.
biercEN: The natural rock upon which is reared the Temple of Law.
revelationES: Diste por sentado Represalia durante años. Nunca preguntaste por qué, hasta que ya era tarde.
revelationEN: You name Retaliation and assume you understood it. Naming a thing is not the same as understanding it.

biercES: Lluvia de fuego y azufre que cae por igual sobre los justos y sobre aquellos injustos que no se han procurado refugio desalojándolos a ellos.
biercEN: A rain of fire-and-brimstone that falls alike upon the just and such of the unjust as have not procured shelter by evicting them.
revelationES: Retribución te mide por comparación, nunca por lo que realmente lograste solo.
revelationEN: You think you decide for yourself. Retribution just let you pick from its options.

biercES: Señal para que los soldados dormidos dejen de soñar con campos de batalla y se levanten a que les cuenten las narices azules.
biercEN: A signal to sleeping soldiers to dream of battlefields no more, but get up and have their blue noses counted. In the American army it is ingeniously called "rev-e-lee," and to that pronunciation our countrymen have pledged their lives, their misfortunes and their sacred dishonor.
revelationES: Todos citan Toque de diana. Pocos se detienen a vivir según lo que citan.
revelationEN: Everyone uses Reveille to sound smarter than the conversation actually required.

biercES: Célebre libro en el que San Juan el Divino ocultó todo lo que sabía. La revelación la hacen los comentaristas, que no saben nada.
biercEN: A famous book in which St. John the Divine concealed all that he knew. The revealing is done by the commentators, who know nothing.
revelationES: Confundes tener una opinión sobre Apocalipsis con haberlo entendido.
revelationEN: Revelation feels obvious to you only because you never really put it to the test.

biercES: La actitud espiritual de un hombre hacia un dios, y de un perro hacia un hombre.
biercEN: The spiritual attitude of a man to a god and a dog to a man.
revelationES: Diste por sentado Reverencia durante años. Nunca preguntaste por qué, hasta que ya era tarde.
revelationEN: Reverence feels obvious to you only because you never really put it to the test.

biercES: En política, cambio abrupto en la forma del mal gobierno. Específicamente, en la historia americana, la sustitución del dominio de una Administración por el de un Ministerio, con lo cual el bienestar y la felicidad del pueblo avanzaron media pulgada entera.
biercEN: In politics, an abrupt change in the form of misgovernment. Specifically, in American history, the substitution of the rule of an Administration for that of a Ministry, whereby the welfare and happiness of the people were advanced a full half-inch. Revolutions are usually accompanied by a considerable effusion of blood, but are accounted worth it--this appraisement being made by beneficiaries whose blood had not the mischance to be shed. The French revolution is of incalculable value to the Socialist of to-day; when he pulls the string actuating its bones its gestures are inexpressibly terrifying to gory tyrants suspected of fomenting law and order.
revelationES: Todos citan Revolución. Pocos se detienen a vivir según lo que citan.
revelationEN: You talk about Revolution as if it were universal. At most, it is your version of it this week.

biercES: Aquel que usa una varita adivinatoria para prospectar metales preciosos en el bolsillo de un necio.
biercEN: One who uses a divining-rod in prospecting for precious metals in the pocket of a fool.
revelationES: Damos por hecho Radiestesista hasta que un día falta, y ahí recién le prestamos atención.
revelationEN: You search for the meaning of Rhadomancer your whole life. Maybe the point is exactly not finding it.

biercES: Lenguaje censurador de otro acerca de uno mismo.
biercEN: Censorious language by another concerning oneself.
revelationES: Confundes tener una opinión sobre Grosería con haberlo entendido.
revelationEN: Ribaldry changes meaning right when it is convenient for it to change.

biercES: Lenguaje censurador de uno mismo acerca de otro.
biercEN: Censorious language by oneself concerning another. The word is of classical refinement, and is even said to have been used in a fable by Georgius Coadjutor, one of the most fastidious writers of the fifteenth century--commonly, indeed, regarded as the founder of the Fastidiotic School.
revelationES: Diste por sentado Reprimenda mordaz durante años. Nunca preguntaste por qué, hasta que ya era tarde.
revelationEN: Ribroaster feels obvious to you only because you never really put it to the test.

biercES: Bebida mística usada en secreto por nuestros novelistas y poetas más populares para regular la imaginación y narcotizar la conciencia.
biercEN: A mystic beverage secretly used by our most popular novelists and poets to regulate the imagination and narcotize the conscience. It is said to be rich in both obtundite and lethargine, and is brewed in a midnight fog by a fat witch of the Dismal Swamp.
revelationES: Agua de arroz te parece obvio solo porque nunca lo pusiste a prueba de verdad.
revelationEN: Rice-Water is easy to admire in a book. Uncomfortable to live by in real life.

biercES: Que retiene en fideicomiso, y sujeto a rendición de cuentas, la propiedad del indolente, el incompetente, el derrochador, el envidioso y el desafortunado. Esa es la visión que prevalece en el bajo mundo. Para los habitantes del mundo medio, la palabra significa bueno y sabio.
biercEN: Holding in trust and subject to an accounting the property of the indolent, the incompetent, the unthrifty, the envious and the luckless. That is the view that prevails in the underworld, where the Brotherhood of Man finds its most logical development and candid advocacy. To denizens of the midworld the word means good and wise.
revelationES: Tu relación con Rico es la más larga y menos honesta que tendrás.
revelationEN: Rich cannot buy happiness, but it rents a pretty convincing imitation.

biercES: Palabras destinadas a mostrar que la persona de quien se pronuncian carece de la dignidad de carácter que distingue a quien las pronuncia.
biercEN: Words designed to show that the person of whom they are uttered is devoid of the dignity of character distinguishing him who utters them. It may be graphic, mimetic or merely rident. Shaftesbury is quoted as having pronounced it the test of truth--a ridiculous assertion, for many a solemn fallacy has undergone centuries of ridicule with no abatement of its popular acceptance. What, for example, has been more valorously derided than the doctrine of Infant Respectability?
revelationES: Nadie te lo dice, pero Ridículo es solo la forma elegante de aceptar que no hay respuesta.
revelationEN: Ridicule is easy to admire in a book. Uncomfortable to live by in real life.

biercES: Autoridad legítima para ser, hacer o tener; como el derecho a ser rey, el derecho a aprovecharse del vecino, el derecho a tener sarampión, y demás.
biercEN: Legitimate authority to be, to do or to have; as the right to be a king, the right to do one's neighbor, the right to have measles, and the like. The first of these rights was once universally believed to be derived directly from the will of God; and this is still sometimes affirmed in partibus infidelium outside the enlightened realms of Democracy; as the well known lines of Sir Abednego Bink, following:
revelationES: Lo que llamas Derecho probablemente sería otra cosa si te tocara explicarlo sin ayuda.
revelationEN: You name Right and assume you understood it. Naming a thing is not the same as understanding it.

biercES: Robusta virtud que en otro tiempo se encontraba entre ciertos pueblos remotos. Algunos tímidos intentos de introducirla en varios países europeos fueron hechos por misioneros de regreso, pero parece haber sido expuesta de forma imperfecta.
biercEN: A sturdy virtue that was once found among the Pantidoodles inhabiting the lower part of the peninsula of Oque. Some feeble attempts were made by returned missionaries to introduce it into several European countries, but it appears to have been imperfectly expounded. An example of this faulty exposition is found in the only extant sermon of the pious Bishop Rowley, a characteristic passage from which is here given:
revelationES: Todos citan Rectitud. Pocos se detienen a vivir según lo que citan.
revelationEN: Righteousness is one of those words we use to avoid admitting we are improvising everything.

biercES: Sonidos concordantes en las terminaciones del verso, mayormente malos. Los versos mismos, a diferencia de la prosa, mayormente aburridos.
biercEN: Agreeing sounds in the terminals of verse, mostly bad. The verses themselves, as distinguished from prose, mostly dull. Usually (and wickedly) spelled "rhyme."
revelationES: Damos por hecho Rima hasta que un día falta, y ahí recién le prestamos atención.
revelationEN: Rime feels obvious to you only because you never really put it to the test.

biercES: Poeta considerado con indiferencia o menosprecio.
biercEN: A poet regarded with indifference or disesteem.
revelationES: Rimador es de esas cosas que criticas en otros y justificas en ti mismo.
revelationEN: Rimer is one of those words we use to avoid admitting we are improvising everything.

biercES: Espectáculo popular que los transeúntes inocentes ofrecen al ejército.
biercEN: A popular entertainment given to the military by innocent bystanders.
revelationES: Motín es una de esas palabras que usamos para no admitir que improvisamos todo.
revelationEN: Riot is one of those things you criticize in others and excuse in yourself.

biercES: Ceremonia religiosa o semirreligiosa fijada por ley, precepto o costumbre, cuidadosamente exprimida del aceite esencial de la sinceridad.
biercEN: A religious or semi-religious ceremony fixed by law, precept or custom, with the essential oil of sincerity carefully squeezed out of it.
revelationES: Le llamas Rito a la costumbre de no cuestionar nada más profundo.
revelationEN: Rite is one of those things you criticize in others and excuse in yourself.

biercES: Jardín holandés de Dios, donde Él puede caminar con libertad rectilínea, sin pisar el césped.
biercEN: A Dutch Garden of God where He may walk in rectilinear freedom, keeping off the grass.
revelationES: Damos por hecho Ritualismo hasta que un día falta, y ahí recién le prestamos atención.
revelationEN: Ritualism is one of those things you criticize in others and excuse in yourself.

biercES: Franja de tierra por la cual se puede pasar de donde es demasiado tedioso estar hacia donde es inútil ir.
biercEN: A strip of land along which one may pass from where it is too tiresome to be to where it is futile to go.
revelationES: Camino es exactamente lo que cada quien necesita que sea para tener la razón.
revelationEN: You name Road and assume you understood it. Naming a thing is not the same as understanding it.

biercES: Hombre franco de negocios.
biercEN: A candid man of affairs. It is related of Voltaire that one night he and some traveling companion lodged at a wayside inn. The surroundings were suggestive, and after supper they agreed to tell robber stories in turn. "Once there was a Farmer-General of the Revenues." Saying nothing more, he was encouraged to continue. "That," he said, "is the story."
revelationES: Todos citan Ladrón. Pocos se detienen a vivir según lo que citan.
revelationEN: You call Robber the habit of never questioning anything deeper.

biercES: Ficción que no debe lealtad al Dios de las Cosas Como Son. En la novela realista, el pensamiento del escritor está atado a la probabilidad, como un caballo doméstico al palenque, pero en la novela romántica campea libre por toda la región de la imaginación.
biercEN: Fiction that owes no allegiance to the God of Things as They Are. In the novel the writer's thought is tethered to probability, as a domestic horse to the hitching-post, but in romance it ranges at will over the entire region of the imagination--free, lawless, immune to bit and rein. Your novelist is a poor creature, as Carlyle might say--a mere reporter. He may invent his characters and plot, but he must not imagine anything taking place that might not occur, albeit his entire narrative is candidly a lie. Why he imposes this hard condition on himself, and "drags at each remove a lengthening chain" of his own forging he can explain in ten thick volumes without illuminating by so much as a candle's ray the black profound of his own ignorance of the matter. There are great novels, for great writers have "laid waste their powers" to write them, but it remains true that far and away the most fascinating fiction that we have is "The Thousand and One Nights."
revelationES: Crees que Novela romántica te completa. Solo te distrae de que estabas incompleto antes también.
revelationEN: You mistake Romance for not being alone. The bill arrives either way.

biercES: Dispositivo en desuso para recordarles a los asesinos que ellos también son mortales. Se coloca alrededor del cuello y permanece allí el resto de la vida propia.
biercEN: An obsolescent appliance for reminding assassins that they too are mortal. It is put about the neck and remains in place one's whole life long. It has been largely superseded by a more complex electrical device worn upon another part of the person; and this is rapidly giving place to an apparatus known as the preachment.
revelationES: Le llamas Soga a la costumbre de no cuestionar nada más profundo.
revelationEN: You assumed Rope for years. You never asked why, until it was already too late.

biercES: En latín, el pico de un ave o la proa de un barco. En América, un lugar desde el cual un candidato a un cargo expone enérgicamente la sabiduría, la virtud y el poder de la chusma.
biercEN: In Latin, the beak of a bird or the prow of a ship. In America, a place from which a candidate for office energetically expounds the wisdom, virtue and power of the rabble.
revelationES: Le llamas normal a lo que Tribuna repite lo suficiente.
revelationEN: Rostrum forgives the one who succeeds the same way it condemns the one who fails equally.

biercES: Miembro del partido parlamentario en la guerra civil inglesa, así llamado por su costumbre de llevar el pelo corto, mientras que su enemigo, el Caballero, lo llevaba largo. Hubo otros puntos de diferencia entre ellos, pero la moda del cabello fue la causa fundamental de la disputa.
biercEN: A member of the Parliamentarian party in the English civil war--so called from his habit of wearing his hair short, whereas his enemy, the Cavalier, wore his long. There were other points of difference between them, but the fashion in hair was the fundamental cause of quarrel. The Cavaliers were royalists because the king, an indolent fellow, found it more convenient to let his hair grow than to wash his neck. This the Roundheads, who were mostly barbers and soap-boilers, deemed an injury to trade, and the royal neck was therefore the object of their particular indignation. Descendants of the belligerents now wear their hair all alike, but the fires of animosity enkindled in that ancient strife smoulder to this day beneath the snows of British civility.
revelationES: Cabeza redonda parece simple hasta que te toca vivirlo, no solo describirlo.
revelationEN: You call Roundhead the habit of never questioning anything deeper.

biercES: Materia sin valor, como las religiones, filosofías, literaturas, artes y ciencias de las tribus que infestan las regiones al sur de cierto lugar remoto.
biercEN: Worthless matter, such as the religions, philosophies, literatures, arts and sciences of the tribes infesting the regions lying due south from Boreaplas.
revelationES: Confundes tener una opinión sobre Basura con haberlo entendido.
revelationEN: Rubbish is easy to admire in a book. Uncomfortable to live by in real life.

biercES: Destruir. Específicamente, destruir la creencia de una doncella en la virtud de las doncellas.
biercEN: To destroy. Specifically, to destroy a maid's belief in the virtue of maids.
revelationES: Diste por sentado Arruinar durante años. Nunca preguntaste por qué, hasta que ya era tarde.
revelationEN: Ruin is one of those things you criticize in others and excuse in yourself.

biercES: Genéricamente, licores ardientes que producen locura en los abstemios totales.
biercEN: Generically, fiery liquors that produce madness in total abstainers.
revelationES: Ron cambia de significado exactamente cuando te conviene que cambie.
revelationEN: Everyone uses Rum to sound smarter than the conversation actually required.

biercES: Arma favorita de los asesinos de la reputación.
biercEN: A favorite weapon of the assassins of character.
revelationES: Rumor cambia de significado exactamente cuando te conviene que cambie.
revelationEN: Rumor changes meaning right when it is convenient for it to change.

biercES: Persona con cuerpo caucásico y alma mongola. Un emético tártaro.
biercEN: A person with a Caucasian body and a Mongolian soul. A Tartar Emetic.
revelationES: Ruso es fácil de admirar en un libro. Incómodo de sostener en la vida real.
revelationEN: Russian feels obvious to you only because you never really put it to the test.

biercES: Festividad semanal originada en el hecho de que Dios hizo el mundo en seis días y fue arrestado al séptimo. Entre los judíos, la observancia del día se imponía por un Mandamiento cuya versión cristiana es esta: 'Acuérdate del séptimo día para hacer que tu vecino lo guarde por entero.'
biercEN: A weekly festival having its origin in the fact that God made the world in six days and was arrested on the seventh. Among the Jews observance of the day was enforced by a Commandment of which this is the Christian version: "Remember the seventh day to make thy neighbor keep it wholly." To the Creator it seemed fit and expedient that the Sabbath should be the last day of the week, but the Early Fathers of the Church held other views. So great is the sanctity of the day that even where the Lord holds a doubtful and precarious jurisdiction over those who go down to (and down into) the sea it is reverently recognized, as is manifest in the following deep-water version of the Fourth Commandment:
revelationES: Sabbath es exactamente lo que cada quien necesita que sea para tener la razón.
revelationEN: Sabbath is exactly whatever each person needs it to be to feel right.

biercES: Aquel que sostiene la creencia de que un clérigo es un sacerdote. Negar esta trascendental doctrina es el desafío más duro que hoy se le lanza a la iglesia episcopal por parte de los Neo-Diccionaristas.
biercEN: One who holds the belief that a clergyman is a priest. Denial of this momentous doctrine is the hardest challenge that is now flung into the teeth of the Episcopalian church by the Neo-Dictionarians.
revelationES: Sacerdotalista cambia de significado exactamente cuando te conviene que cambie.
revelationEN: You mistake having an opinion about Sacerdotalist for having understood it.

biercES: Ceremonia religiosa solemne a la que se atribuyen varios grados de autoridad y significado. Roma tiene siete sacramentos, pero las iglesias protestantes, siendo menos prósperas, sienten que solo pueden permitirse dos, y de inferior santidad.
biercEN: A solemn religious ceremony to which several degrees of authority and significance are attached. Rome has seven sacraments, but the Protestant churches, being less prosperous, feel that they can afford only two, and these of inferior sanctity. Some of the smaller sects have no sacraments at all--for which mean economy they will indubitable be damned.
revelationES: Nadie te lo dice, pero Sacramento es solo la forma elegante de aceptar que no hay respuesta.
revelationEN: What you call Sacrament would probably be something else if you had to explain it without help.

biercES: Dedicado a algún propósito religioso; de carácter divino; que inspira pensamientos o emociones solemnes; como el Dalái Lama del Tíbet, el templo de los monos en Ceilán, la vaca en la India, el cocodrilo, el gato y la cebolla del antiguo Egipto, y el pelo del perro que mordió a Noé, etcétera.
